modules.module_title: Receipt of petroleum and allied products

pcs.pc_description: collect details of receipt from operation team
check receipt of material at storage or project site
conduct physical inspection of tank for any leakage or damage
follow safety norms during unloading of petroleum and allied products

modules.module_title: Management of petroleum and allied products storage facility

pcs.pc_description: check all the electrical fittings of storage facility to identify any maintenance requirements
ensure store is free from vegetation
check tanks for any leakages or sweating
carry out repairs of the tank if any scaling or pitting is observed
clean the floating roof deck to avoid clogging of roof drain sump
ensure proper earthing and bonding of tank body and check that there is electrical continuity from shell to ladder and from ladder to floating roof
confirm that drain valve of the tank body is closed
check that isolation valves on expansion line(s)/TSV vent line(s) is open all the time
maintain and update the logbook by entering quantity of petroleum product stored, received and dispatched in the storage facility
monitor the temperature of storage area and products stored using meters and gauges installed in the storage facility

modules.module_title: Labelling and packaging of petroleum and allied products

pcs.pc_description: mark or label stored petroleum and allied products with unique codes
mark storage location with unique code to identify the location
follow statutory norms in stock yard or store building to ensure safety and security
carry out packaging of petroleum and allied products as per SOP

modules.module_title: Issue/dispatch and waste disposal of petroleum and allied products

pcs.pc_description: issue / dispatch petroleum and allied products by following company guidelines and as per approved indent / order
dispose the petroleum waste as per the standard practice followed in the industry

modules.module_title: Ensure fire safety at storage facilities

pcs.pc_description: check availability of fire extinguisher and piping network with fire hydrant at entry door of storage facility /loading and unloading area
check functioning of auto start facility with pressure drops in fire water network
check and confirm the installation of fixed foam system or semi-fixed foam system on all kind of tanks (floating roof or fixed roof)
check that manual type HVLR (High Volume Long Range) monitors are available in storage area in pipeline terminals and central crude tank farms
